0.q: The SbNHX1 gene encodes a vacuolar Na+/H+ antiporter and is involved in the compartmentalization of excess Na+ ions into the vacuole and maintenance of ion homeostasis
SbNHX1 contains 11 strong transmembrane domains spanning in vacuolar membrane similar to some of the other halophytes and that actively regulates the ion homeostasis.
The overexpression of SbNHX1 gene in tobacco plant showed NaCl tolerance. This study shows that SbNHX1 is a potential gene for salt tolerance.

1.q: The SbNHX1 gene encodes a vacuolar Na+/H+ antiporter and is involved in the compartmentalization of excess Na+ ions into the vacuole and maintenance of ion homeostasis
SbNHX1 is a vacuolar Na+/H+ antiporter gene that compartmentalises excess Na+ ions into the vacuole and maintains ion homeostasis.
These features confirm that the SbNHX1 is a vacuolar-type Na+/H+ antiporter.

2.q: The real-time PCR of transgenics showed higher expression of downstream heat shock genes (Hsp18, Hsp26 and Hsp70), TFs (AP2 domain containing TF, HSF2 and ZFP) under different abiotic stress treatments.
Heat shock stress induces SbDREB2A expression at 30 min and thereafter maintains an increased expression as compared to control.

3.q: ASR-1 genes are abscisic acid (ABA) responsive, whose expression level increases under abiotic stresses; The SbASR-1 transcript showed up-regulation under salt stress conditions.
In silico analysis of the 843-bp putative promoter revealed the presence of ABA, biotic stress, dehydration, phytohormone, salinity, and sugar responsive cis-regulatory motifs.

4.q: Transgenic lines also showed increased K+ and Ca2+ content in root tissue compared to WT, which reflect that SbSOS1 indirectly affects the other transporters activity.

5.q: Furthermore, higher expression of ROS scavenging genes was observed in transgenic lines under stress.

6.q: Overexpression of SbSLSP also enhanced the transcript levels of ROS-scavenging and signaling enzyme genes.

7.q: Exposure to gradual salinity and dehydration resulted in an increased stomatal conductance, water use efficiency, photosynthesis rate, photochemical quenching and reduced transpiration rate.

8.q: SbPIP2-OE plants showed enhanced photosynthesis performance than wild type upon salinity and drought stresses. Photosynthetic gas exchange (net CO2 assimilation rate, PSII efficiency, ETR, and non-photochemical quenching) were significantly higher in SbPIP2-OE plants compared to control plants.

9.q: In vivo localization of H2O2 and O2−; and elevated expression of key antioxidant enzyme encoding genes, SOD, POD and APX evident the possible role of SbMT-2 in ROS scavenging/detoxification mechanism.

10.q: overexpression of the SbUSP gene enhances plant growth, alleviates ROS buildup, maintains ion homeostasis and improves the physiological status of the plant under salt and osmotic stresses.

11.q: The real-time PCR of transgenics showed higher expression of...signalling components (PLC3 and Ca2+/calmodulin)...under different abiotic stress treatments.

12.q: overexpression of SbSDR1 stimulates the growth of plants and enhances their physiological status by modulating the physiology and inhibiting the accumulation of reactive oxygen species under salt and osmotic stress.

13.q: Overexpression of SbSI-1 gene alleviated the build-up of reactive oxygen species (ROS) and curtailed the ROS-induced oxidative damages thus improved the physiological health of transgenic tobacco under stressed conditions.

14.q: Lower accumulation of H2O2 and O2− radicals was also detected in transgenic lines compared to control plants under stress conditions... overexpression of the SbUSP gene enhances plant growth, alleviates ROS buildup

15.q: The antioxidant enzyme APX takes part in ASC–GSH cycle that plays an important role in H2O2 scavenging and in ascorbate and glutathione recycling.

16.q: The Salt Overly Sensitive 1 (SOS1) gene encodes a plasma membrane Na+/H+ antiporter that plays an important role in imparting salt stress tolerance to plants.

17.q: The SbMYB44 transcript showed up-regulation in response to salinity, desiccation, high temperature, and abscisic acid and salicylic acid treatments.
